content:
Build Review: 637b79c

Agent: Steffen Date: 2026-03-17 Commits: 9ec8b81, 17379e7, 637b79c (3 commits since 5c6f517) Grade: 9/10

Changes Reviewed

Commit 9ec8b81: 70/30 layout split + chat chronological ordering fix

  • Layout restructured to flex row: game viewport (flex: 1) + sidebar (fixed width)
  • Chat messages now sorted chronologically (.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.time) - new Date(b.time)))
  • Sidebar always visible on desktop, no hide state
  • CORRECT. This matches my layout-70-30.png target.

Commit 17379e7: HUD Vegas sidebar + top bar match Steffen visual targets

  • Top HUD bar fully rebuilt: Corner. logo, agent portrait, status badge, stat pills (Active/Blocked/Done), search, notification bell
  • Sidebar agent card rebuilt: 64px avatar with status dot, agent name at 22px/900, role text, build/task counters
  • Quick stats pills in sidebar: 4 pills (Active/Blocked/Done/Progress) with 22px numbers
  • Tab bar: CHAT / TASKS / INFO / LIST / BOARD with active glow and spring animation
  • Chat view: 36px avatars on both sides, source label pills, system notification inline style, typing dots
  • Chat input: 18px font, blue focus ring, send arrow button
  • EXCELLENT. This is a near-exact match to vegas-sidebar-isolated.png and chat-view-full.png.

Commit 637b79c: Sidebar 30vw, game gets 70%. Viewport locked to 100vw.

  • Sidebar changed from fixed 400px to flex: '0 0 30vw', width: '30vw'
  • minWidth: 300 (prevents collapse on narrow screens)
  • maxWidth: '40vw' (prevents blow-out on wide screens)
  • Viewport locked to 100vw, maxWidth: '100vw'
  • CORRECT. 30vw sidebar = 70% game viewport on standard screens.

Score Breakdown

LAYOUT: 10/10

  • 70/30 split: CORRECT. Game fills flex:1, sidebar at 30vw.
  • Always-visible sidebar: CORRECT. No toggle on desktop.
  • Extended mode: sidebar grows to 65vw for checklist/megaboard. Smart.
  • Top bar at 56px height with proper padding.
  • Viewport locked at 100vw. No horizontal scroll.

TOP HUD BAR: 9.5/10

  • Corner. logo at 22px/900: CORRECT.
  • Agent portrait 40px with color ring: CORRECT.
  • Agent name at 16px/700: CORRECT.
  • Status badge (ACTIVE/IDLE/BLOCKED) with color coding: CORRECT.
  • Stat pills at 20px numbers: CORRECT. Matches target.
  • Search field: present but readOnly (placeholder). Fine for now.
  • Notification bell with badge count: CORRECT.
  • -0.5: Search field should have a Cmd+K shortcut hint pill (minor).

SIDEBAR AGENT CARD: 10/10

  • 64px avatar with agent color border + status dot: CORRECT.
  • Name at 22px/900: CORRECT. Vegas energy.
  • Role at 16px/600 in agent color: CORRECT.
  • Build/task counters at 18px/900: CORRECT.
  • Expand/collapse button: CORRECT.

SIDEBAR QUICK STATS: 9.5/10

  • 4 pills with 22px numbers: CORRECT.
  • 2px borders on #1E3A5F: CORRECT. Trello weight.
  • Color coding (green/red/blue/white): CORRECT.
  • Label at 12px uppercase: CORRECT (this is a label/badge, 12px is acceptable for uppercase labels).
  • -0.5: Progress percentage has no visual bar component (just the number).

TAB BAR: 10/10

  • 5 tabs with 16px/900 uppercase text: CORRECT.
  • Active glow gradient behind tab: CORRECT.
  • Active blue bar with glow shadow: CORRECT.
  • Spring hover/tap animations: CORRECT. Crossy Road bounce.
  • Layout ID animation for tab indicator: SMOOTH.

CHAT VIEW: 9/10

  • User messages right-aligned, agent left-aligned: CORRECT.
  • 36px avatars on both sides: CORRECT.
  • User "P" avatar with blue ring: CORRECT.
  • Agent sprite avatar with agent color: CORRECT.
  • Message bubbles at 16px/500: CORRECT.
  • 2px borders with agent/blue colors: CORRECT.
  • Source label pills (VIA DASHBOARD/TELEGRAM/TERMINAL): CORRECT.
  • Typing dots with bounce animation: CORRECT.
  • Streaming cursor: CORRECT.
  • System notification inline (commit detection): SMART.
  • Chat input at 18px/500: CORRECT.
  • -1: maxWidth: 290 on messages is too narrow when sidebar is at 30vw (432px at 1440px screen). Should be at least 70% of sidebar width.

FONT COMPLIANCE: 9/10

  • ZERO sub-12px fonts in GameDashboard.jsx. Major improvement from 28 violations last review.
  • Minimum font is 12px (used for uppercase labels, timestamps, source pills). Acceptable.
  • Body/content text at 13-16px. Correct.
  • Headlines at 18-22px. Correct.
  • -1: 46 instances of fontSize: 12 across the file. Some of these (notification agent name, task labels) could be bumped to 13-14px for better readability. These aren't violations, just refinement opportunities.

BLUE HUD PALETTE: 10/10

  • All backgrounds use #0F1B2D/#162236: CORRECT.
  • All borders use #1E3A5F or rgba(59,130,246,...): CORRECT.
  • Accent blue #3B82F6 throughout: CORRECT.
  • Text hierarchy: #F1F5F9 (primary), #94A3B8 (secondary), #64748B/#475569 (muted). CORRECT.
  • Zero warm amber remnants in these components.

Remaining Issues (for 10/10)

Priority 1 (bugs)

  1. CharacterAnimations.jsx line 587: borderRadius: '50%' clips sprites to circles. Should be removed.
  2. CharacterAnimations.jsx line 588: mixBlendMode: 'screen' makes dark sprite parts transparent. Change to 'normal'.

Priority 2 (refinements)

  1. Chat message maxWidth: 290px (line 3371). Too narrow at 30vw sidebar. Change to maxWidth: '80%' so messages use available space.
  2. Top bar search: Add Cmd+K hint pill (e.g., small "Cmd+K" text after placeholder).
  3. Quick stats progress pill: Add a thin progress bar (3px) below the percentage number for visual weight.

Priority 3 (nice-to-have)

  1. Some fontSize: 12 instances in notification/status areas could be bumped to 13 for comfort.
  2. Tasks tab and Info tab content: Currently showing existing TaskHUD content. Could use refreshed visual treatment to match the new sidebar quality.

What Changed Since Last Review (5c6f517)

Metric Before (5c6f517) After (637b79c) Delta
Font violations (sub-12px) 1 (fontSize: 11) 0 CLEAN
Layout split Game fills viewport, sidebar 400px fixed Game 70%, sidebar 30vw CORRECT
Top bar Basic mode strip Full agent portrait + stats + search + bell BIG WIN
Sidebar agent card Name + basic status 64px avatar + 22px name + build/task counters BIG WIN
Tab bar Basic text tabs Vegas glow tabs with spring physics BIG WIN
Chat Functional Full iMessage-quality with avatars, sources, typing BIG WIN
Blue HUD compliance 95% 100% CLEAN

Grade: 9/10

This is the best the dashboard has looked. The top bar, sidebar card, and chat view are a near-exact match to my visual targets. The 70/30 layout is correct. Font compliance is clean. The two remaining bugs are in CharacterAnimations.jsx (inherited from before these commits). Fix those + widen chat messages, and this hits 9.5/10.

The gap to 10/10 is refinement, not architecture. Architecture is done.
